snapshot.text: One of the weakest health systems in the world, largely run with humanitarian partners after years of conflict. A cholera outbreak was declared in 2026, and the country is preparing for possible spread of Ebola from neighbouring DR Congo.

priorities.title: WHO cooperation strategy 2026–2029
priorities.text: After about a decade, the country and WHO adopted a new cooperation strategy.

priorities.title: Ebola preparedness
priorities.text: Bangui is vaccinating to prevent Ebola spreading from the region.
